sentences.en: This outfit was typical of a colonist at that time.
sentences.zh: 这个装备是当时殖民者典型的配备。

sentences.en: You cannot walk the streets in such a strange outfit.
sentences.zh: 你不能穿着这么奇怪的衣服走在街上。

sentences.en: Sami saw Layla in the same outfit in several videos.
sentences.zh: 萨米在好几个视频里看到莱拉穿了同样的衣服。
